abstract_en: Microfluidics attracts much attention due to its multiple advantages such as high throughput, rapid analysis, low sample volume, and high sensitivity. Microfluidics has profoundly influenced many fields including chemistry, biology, medicine, information technology, and other disciplines. However, some stumbling stones (miniaturization, integration, and intelligence) strain the development of industrialization and commercialization of microchips. The miniaturization of microfluidics means fewer samples and reagents, shorter times to results, and less footprint space consumption, enabling a high throughput and parallelism of sample analysis. Additionally, micro-size channels tend to produce laminar flow, which probably permits some creative applications that are not accessible to traditional fluid-processing platforms. The reasonable integration of biomedical/physical biosensors, semiconductor microelectronics, communications, and other cutting-edge technologies should greatly expand the applications of current microfluidic devices and help develop the next generation of lab-on-a-chip (LOC). At the same time, the evolution of artificial intelligence also gives another strong impetus to the rapid development of microfluidics. Biomedical applications based on microfluidics normally bring a large amount of complex data, so it is a big challenge for researchers and technicians to analyze those huge and complicated data accurately and quickly. To address this problem, machine learning is viewed as an indispensable and powerful tool in processing the data collected from micro-devices. In this review, we mainly focus on discussing the integration, miniaturization, portability, and intelligence of microfluidics technology.
abstract_zh: 综述生物医学微流控系统的集成、可穿戴应用与人工智能进展：微流控具高通量、低成本、便携潜力，AI驱动信号处理与决策，面向连续健康监测与可穿戴诊断。
background_zh: 生物医学微流控在生化检测、细胞分析方面进展迅速；但设备集成、可穿戴化与数据智能化仍面临挑战。
problem_zh: 如何把微流控芯片与传感/信号处理/可穿戴平台整合，并借助AI提升临床/居家监测价值？
data_zh: 综述论文：涵盖微流控-传感集成、可穿戴贴片/微针/生物流体分析、AI信号解码等文献案例。
task_zh: 梳理“集成-可穿戴-AI”三要素在生物医学微流控系统中的角色与融合方式。
method_zh: 从器件材料/结构、集成传感（电化学/光学/微机电）、可穿戴形态（贴片、腕带、微针）、AI信号处理与决策四方面综述，归纳应用（汗液/泪液/血液监测等）。
results_zh: 指出AI+集成微流控可把离体检测变成连续、无创的现场监测；可穿戴形式与AI信号降噪/分类结合是主流方向。
innovation_zh: 以“集成+可穿戴+AI”三位一体视角整理生物医学微流控，突出从实验室到日常监测的转化路径。
limitation_zh: 综述定性为主；可穿戴器件的长期稳定性、生物相容性与AI模型泛化仍需工程验证。
paradigm_zh: 可穿戴+AI集成范式：微流控提供样本处理与流体控制，传感器提供信号，AI担当信号解读与健康决策，形成连续监测闭环。
framework_zh: 样本（汗液/血液等）→微流控采样与预处理→集成传感→AI特征提取/分类→健康决策与反馈。
framework_steps: 数据与预处理：生物流体采样、传感信号校正
模型设计：AI降噪/分类/趋势预测模型
训练策略：个体差异校正、实时流式推理
评估与解读：检测一致性、穿戴舒适性、临床有效性
scheme_zh: Scheme展示可穿戴微流控系统从采样、传感、AI解码到用户反馈的架构（PPT用提取的Fig.1）。
lessons_zh: 可穿戴微流控的价值在于“连续+无创+智能”；AI能弥补低信噪比传感的不足，是家用健康监测落地的关键。
title_en: Advances in Integration, Wearable Applications, and Artificial Intelligence of Biomedical Microfluidics Systems
title_zh: 生物医学微流控系统的集成、可穿戴应用与人工智能进展
